description: Ponta Delgada - Rede Viária is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Município de Ponta Delgada. Road Network of the Municipality of Ponta Delgada, classified as type and toponymic designation, extension. Coverage: Município de Ponta Delgada. The portal shows the English title as "Ponta Delgada - Road Network" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Município de Ponta Delgada. Its keywords include vias-de-comunicacao, estrada, caminhos, rede-viaria, estradas. The listing shows 6 download or service links in XML, SBN, PRJ, SHX. The listing shows 2025-09-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
